title: NFL moves up date of the cutdown deadline to 53 players

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL moves up date of the cutdown deadline to 53 players
sources.description: The NFL has informed teams that this year’s cutdown deadline to 53 players has moved up by two days compared to what it was in recent years.
